test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC loss criterion by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward scores
test_asg_criterion: test the Average Sequence Loss criterion using transition graphs, emissions, and forward score composition
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the Viterbi path decoding by composing emissions with transitions and extracting the optimal label sequence
create_emissions_graph: create a linear emissions graph from a probability vector with configurable time steps and output classes
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC lattice graph from a target label sequence and blank token for connectionist temporal classification
